description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to container management using runc, including RunCContainer and RunCContainerAdministrator, within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, implementing the IContainer interface with methods to control container lifecycle and retrieve info.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory and manager class for creating and initializing RunCContainer instances, implementing IContainerProducer.

methods.name: RunCContainer(const string& id, const string& path, const string& logPath)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a RunCContainer with specified id, path, and log path.

methods.name: Type()
methods.description: Returns the container type, specifically RUNC.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, with a timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Retrieves memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo()
methods.description: Retrieves processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces()
methods.description: Retrieves network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Performs internal cleanup or purge of the container.

methods.name: Container(const string& id, IStringIterator& searchpaths, const string& logpath, const string& configuration)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on provided parameters.

methods.name: Initialize(const string& configuration)
methods.description: Initializes the container manager with a given configuration.
